name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.base.TransferHelperActivity
description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit requests camera or microphone access, or asks the user to confirm a call-type change from the floating call window, this temporary Activity runs the request and returns its result.
disableEffect: Permission requests or audio/video call-type changes may fail because their results cannot return to the call screen.
